homeMsg: CBIC is pleased to announce the launch of a revamped tax information portal, through which all indirect tax legislations, rules, regulations, forms, notifications, finance acts, amendments and ordinances will be available for ease of reference of taxpayers. The content on this portal (including hindi version) is being continuously updated and expanded in a phased-manner. Eventually, information under all categories in Customs, GST, Central Excise and erstwhile Service Tax will be available. In case, any user comes across any anomaly or error in content, it is requested to please notify CBIC on feedback.taxinfo@icegate.gov.in

disclaimerPopup: The updated version of the contents including acts, rules, regulations, forms, text of amended notifications (as on date) has been prepared for convenience and easy reference of the stakeholders and does not have legal binding or force. Notifications as published in the Official Gazette of Government of India should be referred for legal purposes. It is our endeavour to make available correct and updated version of the contents on this portal. However, any inadvertent errors in the contents, or any feedback or suggestions on the portal may kindly be brought to notice by sending an email on:<a href="mailto:feedback.taxinfo@icegate.gov.in">feedback.taxinfo@icegate.gov.in
